siteTitle.description: Default site title used by the head config when a page does not provide its own title.

styleFileName.description: CSS file name written to the output directory.

styleHref.description: Public href injected into rendered pages for the site stylesheet.

styleThemes.description: Theme names to emit as stylesheets. Must include light and dark.

navigation.description: Navigation menu configuration for auto/custom/hybrid menus.

navFileName.description: Filename used for custom navigation definitions.

maxDepth.description: Maximum folder depth for nested navigation.

includeIndex.description: Whether index pages appear in auto navigation.

outDir.description: Output directory path. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.
